unit.title: Probability Models as Reproducible Software: Collision Risk
learning_outcomes: Translate a collision-risk problem into an explicit finite probability model.
Implement exact and Monte Carlo calculations behind a stable Python interface.
Control randomness and define a machine-readable experiment record for reproducibility.
Use deterministic tests and statistically justified checks without creating flaky tests.
Explain assumptions, numerical limitations, and evidence from an experiment.
